title: Model Picker and Live Request Composer Visual Asset Bundle
creator: Lina Gomez
description: Create a compact, annotated screenshot set for the Hosted API onboarding flow that showcases the model selector, the live request composer (request builder), and multi-language code snippets. Assets must be export-ready for docs, console help panels, and in-product first-run experience.
deliverables: Model picker modal: compact + expanded variants (light + dark)
Request composer: prefilled chat example, streaming toggle, function-calling sample
Code snippet tab: Python, JavaScript, cURL with copy button visible
Annotated overlay frames for docs explaining: model tiers, latency hints, token cost breakdown
Export-ready PNGs and SVGs at 2x and 3x for retina displays
A condensed hero GIF demoing request->streaming response within the composer
export_spec: PNG: 2x and 3x, 1200px width for hero images
SVG: iconography and picker components (separate layers)
GIF: 720px width, 15s max, loop once for docs hero
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting with PM and eng to align on copy and model labels (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o-legacy, embed-1).
2026-03-02: Initial Figma frames created for model picker compact/expanded. Decided to show latency estimate badges and a small cost-per-1k-tokens hint.
2026-03-03: Built request composer mock with streaming indicator and function-calling example; drafted Python/JS/cURL snippets.
review_comments: PM (Ravi Patel) 2026-03-04: Clarify label for 'capabilities' chip to 'capabilities & tradeoffs' — accepted.
Engineering (Sofia Alvarez) 2026-03-05: Recommend removing detailed token math from hero screenshot; keep abbreviated cost hint and link to cost explainer — applied.
Docs (Ethan Park) 2026-03-05: Code snippets should include snippet title and version comment (e.g., '# SDK v2.1') — updated.
Design lead (Maya Singh) 2026-03-06: Approve light/dark variants; request 1 additional compact layout for narrow mobile view — added to scope.
decisions: Favor compact model picker by default in docs; expanded picker used in console onboarding walkthrough.
Show latency badge (green/yellow/red) with microcopy tooltip rather than exact ms to avoid regional variance confusion.
Include streaming toggle state in request composer screenshots to illustrate real-time capability.
Export assets in both light and dark themes and include a mobile-narrow variant for in-app help panels.
links: API reference anchors to include in overlay: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/hosted-api
Internal SLO dashboard for latency examples: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hostedapi/slo
notes: Avoid using real customer requests or PII in prototype screenshots.
Coordinate with engineering to get up-to-date model capability badges before final export.
Deliverables must be uploaded to Drive folder with flat filenames and a README describing intended use for docs vs console.
